dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source receipt system), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) data-check subsystem; pre-processing for checklist generation, handling multiple insurance (hoken) error patient files
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It performs pre-processing for a data-check checklist, reading a check-result intermediate file (DTCHK004), consolidating records by patient ID and insurance category, and writing/updating a multiple-insurance error patient file (DTCHK007). It is called as a subprogram and returns a return code.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with USING clause (called as subprogram)
16 COPY statements for modular copybook includes
Indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC access (DTCHK004, DTCHK007)
REDEFINES on CONST-HKNKBN-VAL for table access
PERFORM VARYING with inline UNTIL conditions
DB access via MCP (MCPDATA.INC / MCPAREA) abstraction layer
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (692 total lines); comments contain Shift-JIS Japanese text decoded as latin-1, appearing as mojibake. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS; DB access is via a proprietary MCP abstraction layer typical of ORCA.
